reference: English Vocabulary Profile A1-A2 (jobs, workplaces); Cambridge A2 Key-style gap-fill and matching
matching: Items 1-2 gap-fill job from workplace + task; 3-4 choice of workplace for a job; EC = wrong job-noun form (slot 5) and an Arabic-L1 i/e spelling slip on a job noun (slot 6); FP = one sentence linking a given job to its workplace; transfer = a job advert line. Jobs/workplaces EVP A1-A2, prompts 9-15 words. Item order identical across forms: 1-2 controlled gap-fill, 3-4 controlled choice, 5-6 error correction, 7-8 free production (target_form_0_1_2), 9 transfer. Review round 1: slot 5 = wrong job-noun form, slot 6 = job/workplace mismatch; slots 7-8 keyed on the workplace. Review round 3: slot 6 job/workplace mismatches (factual absurdities, two fix directions) replaced by article_indef_omission before the job noun in all forms ('My mother is nurse in a big hospital' -> a nurse); one fix direction. Review round 4: slot 6 article omission tested grammar, not job vocabulary, and A-6 'nurse ... hospital' cued A-1. Slot 6 is now an i/e spelling slip on a job noun (Arabic /i/-/e/ merge) in all forms: artest (A), dentest (B), engeneer (C). Each job noun is not keyed or shown elsewhere in its form. outcomes.json l1ErrorTypes = [spelling_vowel]. Review round 5: A-6 'pharmacist' (EVP B1) -> 'artist' (A2), not keyed or shown elsewhere in form A.
